taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-15 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-15
Curve type: A-type (resistivity rises progressively with depth, with a minor fracture-related dip around 25–27 m before increasing into the resistive basement)
Aquifer depth: 25.09 m – 27.32 m
Recommendation: Target the fractured zone between ~25 m and 27 m depth, marked by the local drop in resistivity (indicating secondary porosity/possible water storage) sandwiched within the otherwise high-resistivity basement sequence. Case the borehole through the overlying resistive overburden (0–25 m) to maintain hole stability before penetrating the fracture zone.
